derivation.method: One-time deterministic RGBA palette separation from the frozen composite. Pixels matching the frozen navy #123048 within Euclidean RGB distance 105 or warm gold #DAA02D within distance 115 receive linearly derived alpha; hue guards reject non-ink pixels. Source RGB is retained for selected pixels; zero-alpha pixels are transparent black. No resize or coordinate transform is applied.
